question: How much does the Pro plan cost per month?
expected: $8 per month.

question: What is the annual price of Pro?
expected: $80 per year when billed annually.

question: How much is the Team plan per user?
expected: $15 per user per month, or $150 per user per year.

question: What is the minimum number of users on the Team plan?
expected: 3 users.

question: How many devices can I use on the free plan?
expected: Up to 2 devices.

question: Do students get a discount?
expected: Yes, 50% off Pro with a valid school email address.

question: Can I combine the student discount with the non-profit discount?
expected: No, discounts cannot be combined.

question: Does the Team plan support SSO?
expected: Yes, SSO with Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.

question: How long is version history kept on Pro?
expected: 1 year.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
expected: Visa, Mastercard, American Express and PayPal; UPI in India for annual plans.

question: Can I pay with UPI?
expected: Yes, in India, for annual plans.

question: What happens if my payment fails?
expected: It is retried three times over 7 days; if all fail the account moves to the Free plan and nothing is deleted.

question: Where can I download my invoices?
expected: Settings > Billing > Invoices, as a PDF.

question: How do I add my company's tax ID to invoices?
expected: Enter it under Settings > Billing > Billing details.

question: How much GST is charged in India?
expected: 18% GST.

question: I was charged twice this month, can I get my money back?
expected: Yes, the duplicate charge is fully refunded; contact support with the invoice numbers. It takes 5 to 10 business days.

question: How long does a refund take to reach my card?
expected: 5 to 10 business days.

question: Can I get a refund on my annual plan after 2 weeks?
expected: Yes, annual plans are fully refundable within 30 days of the charge.

question: Do you refund partial months on monthly plans?
expected: No, monthly plans are not refunded for partial months; you keep access until the end of the month.

question: Who approves refunds over $100?
expected: A billing specialist, which can take up to 2 business days.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
expected: Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription; the plan stays active until the end of the paid period, then moves to Free.

question: Are my notes deleted when I cancel?
expected: No, notes are never deleted when you cancel.

question: When does a downgrade take effect?
expected: At the end of the current billing period.

question: If I upgrade to Pro, when does it start?
expected: Immediately, with a prorated charge for the rest of the period.

question: Can I switch from annual to monthly billing right away?
expected: No, it takes effect when the annual period ends.

question: I forgot my password, what do I do?
expected: Select Forgot password on the login screen; the reset link expires after 1 hour.

question: How long is the password reset link valid?
expected: 1 hour.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
expected: Settings > Security; authenticator apps and hardware security keys are supported.

question: I lost my 2FA phone and backup codes. How do I get back in?
expected: Contact support; recovery takes 3 business days and requires identity verification.

question: My account is locked after too many login attempts. What now?
expected: Wait 30 minutes or reset your password.

question: Can I restore a deleted account?
expected: Yes, within 14 days by contacting support.

question: How do I delete my account?
expected: Settings > Account > Delete account and confirm with your password.

question: Can a Team member delete their own account?
expected: No, they must ask their team admin to remove them.

question: How do I export all my notes?
expected: Settings > Data > Export all; a download link is emailed, valid for 7 days.

question: Can I export to PDF on the free plan?
expected: No, PDF and Word export are Pro and Team features; Markdown export is on all plans.

question: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
expected: Yes, from .enex files via Settings > Data > Import.

question: My notes are not syncing, what should I check?
expected: Same account on every device, internet connection, force sync, update the app, the Free plan 2-device limit, sign out and in.

question: What does a note with (conflict) in the name mean?
expected: The note was edited on two devices while one was offline; both versions are kept to merge by hand.

question: Can I use notebooks offline on my phone with the free plan?
expected: No, full offline notebooks on mobile are a Pro and Team feature; recently opened notes are cached.

question: Which Android version do I need?
expected: Android 10 and later.

question: Can I password protect a shared link?
expected: Yes, on Pro and Team plans.

question: How far back does the admin audit log go?
expected: 90 days.

question: What is the maximum attachment size on Pro?
Do notes in the Trash count towards my storage?
expected: Yes, for 30 days until the Trash is emptied.

question: Do you use my notes to train AI models?
expected: No.

question: Can my team keep data only in the EU?
expected: Yes, Team plans can choose EU-only storage when the team is created.

question: Is the Slack integration available on the free plan?
expected: No, integrations are Pro and Team only, except Google Calendar.

question: How fast does Pro support reply?
expected: Within 24 hours, 7 days a week.

question: When is planned maintenance?
expected: Sundays between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC.

question: How much storage does the Team plan include?
expected: 1 TB of pooled storage per team.
